title: Canada's counter-tariffs take effect — 15/25/50% on ~C$27.6B of US goods
source: NEWS: Canada's Department of Finance published the product list under the title 'List of products from the United States subject to counter-tariffs effective September 8, 2026' (canada.ca/en/department-finance/news/2026/08/...), and Al Jazeera (2026-08-23) plus NPR (2026-08-22) report the same effective date and rate structure; the Blakes US-Canada tariff timeline, fetched direct 2026-09-09, carries 2026-09-08 as its most recent entry and lists NO dated deadline after it. Filed `estimate` because canada.ca is a foreign-government press release, which the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for, and because this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the DATE is not in doubt
notes: The US-Canada trade war is ENTIRELY untracked by this calendar — the only tariff entry of any kind is us-china-tariff-truce-expiry-2026-11-10 — while 41 tracked events sit within five days of jobs-2026-10-02. Sequence: US Section 338/232 tariffs of 50% took effect on ~$20B of Canadian goods at 00:01 ET 2026-08-22 after talks collapsed; Canada retaliated with 15/25/50% counter-tariffs on ~700 items covering ~C$27.6B of US imports (steel, dairy, appliances, agricultural equipment, pulp and paper, electronics), rate-matched to the US line, effective 2026-09-08. Why a payroll sweep filed it: both legs land INSIDE the September reference month this calendar's 2026-10-02 Employment Situation measures, and they hit exactly the goods-producing and agricultural-equipment payrolls the establishment survey counts — a channel distinct from the oil shock the corridor's ledgers already track. It is also the goods-inflation half of the stagflation pairing those ledgers name (soft labor 10/02 + hot CPI 10/14), and it is a live counterexample to the 2026-08-28 Jackson Hole framing that discounted tariffs as an ongoing inflation source. Filed `medium`, not `high`: a bilateral tariff exchange with a $20B/C$27.6B footprint is smaller than the us-china truce this file already ranks, and no single dated resolution is scheduled. NO FORWARD DATE EXISTS to file instead — the Blakes timeline ends here — so this effective date is the only dated hook the sweep could offer; a future review, escalation or settlement date should be proposed the moment one is published. Discovered during the jobs-2026-10-02 pulse-check adjacency sweep (2026-09-09).
